instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
zone_center = zone["center"]
rim_height = zone.get("rim_height", 0.08)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Grasp purple_pen across short axis
cands = grasp_candidates("purple_pen")
pen_obj = obs["objects"]["purple_pen"]

# Filter for clear candidates grasping across short axis (finger yaw roughly perpendicular to long axis)
best_cand = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True) and c.get("hand_clear", True):
        best_cand = c
        break
if best_cand is None and len(cands) > 0:
    best_cand = cands[0]

# Ensure grip height envelopes thin pen lying on table
best_cand["height"] = max(0.008, pen_obj["height"])
res = grasp(best_cand)

if res.get("holding_something", False):
    safe_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.16
    carry_to(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], height=safe_z - table_z)

    # Orient pen vertically (fingers horizontal, pointing forward/sideways so pen along side is vertical)
    candidate_orientations = [
        ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
        ([0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
        ([-1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
        ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
    ]
    selected_app, selected_fa = candidate_orientations[0]
    for app, fa in candidate_orientations:
        ik = solve_ik(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa)
        if ik.get("reachable", False):
            selected_app, selected_fa = app, fa
            break

    move_gripper(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], safe_z, approach=selected_app, finger_axis=selected_fa, path="line")
    
    # Lower pen into holder opening
    lower_target_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.03
    move_gripper(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], lower_target_z, approach=selected_app, finger_axis=selected_fa, path="line")

    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
